title: Applying for BPL Ration Card in Sabarkantha, Gujarat
facts: In Sabarkantha, BPL (Below Poverty Line) cards are for families living below the state-defined poverty line.
BPL cardholders get subsidized food grains through Fair Price Shops.
process: 1. Ensure your family's name is on the official BPL list published by the Gram Panchayat or Municipality in Sabarkantha.
2. Submit the application at the Taluka Development Office (TDO) or Jan Seva Kendra.
3. Verification includes a field visit by a designated officer.
required_documents: Income certificate showing income below poverty line
fees: No application fee for BPL category.
processing_time: 15 to 45 days due to strict verification.

source.name: Gujarat Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department
